lines.cap: If a horse eats something bad, it can't just bring it back up.
lines.say: If a horse eats something bad, it can't just bring it back up.

lines.cap: The muscle at the bottom of its food pipe is so strong, it works like a one way valve.
lines.say: The muscle at the bottom of its food pipe is so strong, it works like a one way valve.

lines.cap: And the pipe joins the stomach at a sharp angle. When the stomach swells, it squeezes the valve even tighter.
lines.say: And the pipe joins the stomach at a sharp angle. When the stomach swells, it squeezes the valve even tighter.

lines.cap: One idea is that it let wild horses gallop for miles, without anything coming back up.
lines.say: One idea is that it let wild horses gallop for miles, without anything coming back up.

lines.cap: But it makes a swollen, painful belly, called colic, really dangerous.
lines.say: But it makes a swollen, painful belly, called colic, really dangerous.

lines.cap: That's why owners watch for the signs. Pawing, rolling, looking at the belly. And call the vet fast.
lines.say: That's why owners watch for the signs. Pawing, rolling, looking at the belly. And call the vet fast.

lines.cap: So be careful what you feed a horse. What goes in, stays in.
